question: Among cards illustrated by Adam Rex that are of uncommon rarity and have at least one ruling, compute the percentage that are legal in the Commander format and do not have a content warning. Only consider cards that appear in sets released after January 1, 2005.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM legalities l
    WHERE l."XCL_086" = c."XCL_072"
      AND l."XCL_084" = 'commander'
      AND l."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  ) AND c."XCL_064" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c."XCL_001") AS percentage
FROM cards c
WHERE c."XCL_002" = 'Adam Rex'
  AND c."XCL_059" = 'uncommon'
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM rulings r WHERE r."XCL_090" = c."XCL_072")
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sets s WHERE s."XCL_099" = c."XCL_063" AND s."XCL_112" > '2005-01-01')
